name: DNA Grammar Artifacts
description: Placeable wrappers for the live-renderable grammars in /dna. Each one packages a research-render's build code as a registered artifact: the same Sim.build(cfg) call, wrapped in a Node3D scene. Promotes lsystem, pattern, rd, trajectory findings from gallery-only to placeable in any map.
theoreticalGrounding: Federated rendering: each grammar's existing build function becomes a placeable artifact. The 'wrapper' is per-grammar, not central — same architectural commitment as facade_builder.

lsystem_artifact.name: L-System Artifact
lsystem_artifact.description: Placeable lsystem-grammar wrapper. Reads a JSON config (axiom, rules, iterations, walk params, colors) and renders branching tubes via LSystemSim.rewrite + LSystemTurtle.walk + LSystemTurtle.to_tubes. Same build path as render_lsystem.gd and dna_workstation.
lsystem_artifact.qfep_connection: F_order: the rewrite rule applied iteratively until structure emerges.

pattern_artifact.name: Pattern Artifact
pattern_artifact.description: Placeable wallpaper-pattern wrapper. Reads a JSON config (group, motif_seed, palette, tile_size) and renders the resulting pattern as a textured quad facing up — readable as floor tile, banner, or table-top.
pattern_artifact.qfep_connection: F_order: 17 wallpaper groups as the algebraic vocabulary of repetition.

rd_artifact.name: Reaction-Diffusion Artifact
rd_artifact.description: Placeable Gray-Scott reaction-diffusion wrapper. Simulates the chemical field per config (F, K, iterations, grid_size, seed) and renders the result as a colored heightmap mesh. Spots, stripes, mazes, coral, mitosis, chaos — the full Turing zoo.
rd_artifact.qfep_connection: lambda_edge: two chemicals at the boundary of reaction and diffusion produce all of pattern emergence.

mesh_grammar_artifact.name: Mesh Grammar Artifact
mesh_grammar_artifact.description: Placeable mesh-grammar wrapper. Reads a JSON config (seed type, generations, list of rules with selectors and params) and builds the resulting procedural mesh via MeshGrammarNode. Supports basic seeds (cube/sphere/icosahedron) and the standard ops (extrude, inset, bulge, scallop, petal_splay, scatter, etc.). DNA-bridged seeds (CA/RD/L-system) are skipped — those configs fall back to image_billboard.
mesh_grammar_artifact.qfep_connection: F_order: face-rewriting rules applied iteratively until form emerges from a primitive seed.

trajectory_artifact.name: Trajectory Artifact
trajectory_artifact.description: Placeable force-trajectory wrapper. Integrates the configured force system (Lorenz, three-body, double pendulum, etc.) and renders the resulting trails as a single MultiMesh of cylinder segments, colored start→end. Time becomes a spatial axis; chaos becomes sculptural.
trajectory_artifact.qfep_connection: F_order + E_entropy: deterministic forces integrated produce structures that read as chaos.
